description: How a video from make_video, or from a step after one, is going: queued, in_progress, ready or failed. Once ready, each video has after_steps, the steps it offers next with their prices in credits. Each ready video's download_url is made new in every answer and works for the next hour: its download_expires_in_seconds is the seconds it has left as that answer is made. For a later download, call get_video again for a new link. Free.
name: get_video
title: A video
